description: Curated bundled species database for Open Garden Planner. Single source of truth for both species records (pH, NPK demand, sun/water, growth, hardiness) and planting-calendar timing (sow/transplant/harvest weeks relative to last frost). Calendar windows are weeks relative to last frost (negative = before). Harvest windows are weeks relative to last spring frost (consistent with sow/transplant timing; positive = after). NPK demand levels are categorical (high/medium/low/fixer). pH ranges are mineral-soil targets, not absolute hard limits. Records are intended for typical temperate-climate gardens; refine per local conditions. Records tagged regions=arizona_lower_desert are tuned for the Phoenix/Mesa lower desert (USDA zone 9b/10a); their sow/harvest weeks assume a last spring frost of about 10 Feb.
